newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek May inflation to fall to 5.4 pct y/y - source.
newsitem.headline: Greek May inflation to fall to 5.4 pct y/y - source.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation should fall to around 5.4 percent year-on-year in May from 5.9 percent in April, a government source told Reuters.
"May inflation will be in the 5.3 to 5.5 percent range and 5.4 percent looks most probable at this point," the source said.
The source said press reports that inflation will drop to 5.1 percent in May were overly optimistic.
"A figure of 5.1 percent for May inflation is out of reach," he said.
Greece's May CPI-based inflation will be released on Thursday, a National Statistics Service official (NSS) told Reuters.
